about: romsets (2026-11-24): No Mercy Plus V3 WITHOUT WCW/nWo Revenge -- on an install whose roms hold only No Mercy (Rev 1), No Mercy v1.0 and the No Mercy Plus V3 patch. Before (main 0068a05) every built-in pack needed Revenge, so the first start made none and left all of No Mercy Plus's men out: Droz and Raven were given stand-ins (this FAILS there). Now the extras' tables and the content pack are made from No Mercy Plus alone.
